prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Asset type: Star Wars SWUniverse colony-map building sprites.
Input image: ONE USER-APPROVED SIMPLE STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. It establishes the smooth broad matte faces, clean chunky geometry, macro detail density, light-facing roofs, exact near-overhead camera, soft shading and palette. Create the NEW function-specific buildings listed below; never copy the reference subject or its layout.
Art direction: simple pre-rendered 3D RTS game sprite. Broad clean roof plates, softly beveled or rounded macro forms, 5-8 readable structural masses per compound. Sparse thick functional machinery and dark recesses, no fine decorative texture. Restrained studio-like upper-left light and ambient occlusion only inside structural joints. Bright readable roof faces at 40px and 68px.
Camera: HIGH ORTHOGRAPHIC NEAR-VERTICAL aerial view, elevation 80 degrees above the ground. Roofs dominate, front walls extremely shallow; match reference. Broad low colony footprints; no tall monuments or scenic camera.
Background: all space outside each silhouette must be a SINGLE PERFECTLY UNIFORM PURE MAGENTA CHROMA-KEY backing, RGB(255,0,255), hex #FF00FF. Paint magenta, not a transparency preview. No checkerboard, gradient, vignette, halo, fog, black backdrop or shadows on magenta. Preserve tight occlusion only within structures. OPEN ORBITAL DOCKS and gaps between orbital struts must show the SAME PURE MAGENTA as outside, never a dark painted void. No solid orbital floor or background plate.
Constraints: no photorealism, gritty PBR, micro-panel grids, scratches, grunge, corrosion, stippled dirt, bolts everywhere, dense greebles or tangled pipe forests. No text, numbers, logos, watermark, borders, people, animals, vehicles, ships, stars, landscape or terrain. Surface facilities may retain only a compact functional paved foundation following the footprint.
Palette: clean warm ivory-cream duracrete, slate-dark gray technical insets, very few muted rust-orange trims. Subtle broad material shading, not dirty weathering. Match approved cream reference.
Layout: EXACTLY FIVE separate compounds on 1536x1024, 3x2 grid, each in its own 512x512 cell. Order TOP LEFT, TOP CENTER, TOP RIGHT, BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM CENTER. Bottom-right cell remains completely magenta. Each compound at most 430px across with at least 35px solid magenta clearance to its cell edges. Preserve continuous empty magenta corridors along ALL grid boundaries; NEVER cross a cell boundary or share a foundation.
1. Cortosis ore mine: broad compact open extraction pit with stepped metal rim, short drilling gantry, enclosed service block and two visible gray-bronze ore bins. Tiny mineral deposits only within equipment, no full rock terrain.
2. Laminanium ore mine: two short drill heads beside a small polygonal extraction shaft, pale silver ore bins and a rectangular sorting hall; different layout from Cortosis.
3. Quadranium ore mine: wide low excavation ring with a heavy short conveyor crossing one edge, dull blue-gray mineral bins and a compact compression head.
4. Neuranium ore mine: small deep dark excavation opening, squat reinforced drill hub and two dense graphite-black ore bins with a wide service hall.
5. Bronzium ore mine: two small stepped excavation pits linked to a low sorting hall, orange-bronze ore bins and a short horizontal conveyor. Readable distinct paired-pit silhouette.
Keep the simplified geometry, clear functional silhouette and same camera across every compound.
